advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm (via git merge-base) that the new enforce_since ref 8dcef77 does not grandfather any unsigned/forgeable in-scope event that the prior ref ce3f8bc would have enforced, and that the documented pre-flip validation covered every writer.
evidence: src/rebar/_config_schema.py:336-339: 'only events whose introducing commit is `<ref>` or a descendant of it are ENFORCED; pre-existing (ancestor) events are reported but never fail the gate'
src/rebar/_commands/verify_authorship.py:262-266: _is_enforced returns True iff `git merge-base --is-ancestor <since_ref> <commit>` exits 0 — everything before the ref is grandfathered

Diff/commit message: marker 'chosen AFTER the pre-flip validation ... so ALL pre-signing historical + mixed-build unsigned events are grandfathered' — the boundary is deliberately moved forward, and the widened window's safety rests on an out-of-band validation not verifiable from these files
ABSENCE: read-only file tools cannot run git merge-base to confirm the new ref is not an ancestor admitting forgeable in-scope events; reachability of a concrete slip-through is UNVERIFIED
advisory.finding: enforce_since is repinned forward from ce3f8bcbe13d37e93a0758f7f73cb3ebeac3b043 to 8dcef776c3dd9e68935b74b82137e1ffd8f04f10 ('enforcement-cutover marker') in the same change that turns enforcement on. Because the gate only ENFORCES events whose introducing commit is the ref or a descendant of it (ancestors are grandfathered/reported-only), moving the boundary forward widens the grandfather window: any in-scope unsigned/forged event whose introducing commit is not a descendant of the new marker is silently grandfathered rather than failing the gate. Whether a genuinely-forgeable event falls in that widened window depends on git ancestry between the old and new refs, which is not resolvable from the repo files alone — the commit message asserts (but the diff does not prove) a pre-flip validation that no active writer emits unsigned non-SNAPSHOT in-scope events.
scenarios: An unsigned or wrong-key in-scope mutating event introduced at a commit that is not a descendant of 8dcef77 lands on main without failing verify-identity, because the widened grandfather window covers it.
